subject: Automotive & EVs
title: The Tesla Model S Plaid
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Tesla Model S Plaid.

hook.text: In 2021, Tesla released a sedan that hit 60 mph in under 2 seconds—faster than most supercars.

buildup.text: The Model S Plaid uses three electric motors producing over 1,000 horsepower with instant torque.

discovery.text: It set a production car record at the Nürburgring and a quarter-mile time under 9.3 seconds.

twist.text: It looks like a normal sedan. No spoilers, no wings—just a family car that embarrasses Ferraris.

climax.text: The Plaid proved electric cars aren't just efficient—they can be the fastest things on four wheels.

punchline.text: The fastest sedan in history carries groceries.

quiz.question: How fast does the Model S Plaid reach 60 mph?
